title: Wonder what I look like to her. Height of a tower? No, she can jump me.
html_source:
This is one of several signs that we have shifted to a new protagonist with a different perception of things.
As Patrick Hasting explains: “… the "tower” figures into Mr. Bloom’s curiosity about his cat’s perception of his relative height, not an esoteric figuration of the omphalos of an Irish intellectual movement".

anchor.text: Wonder what I look like to her. Height of a tower? No, she can jump me.
